feature: UI-FIDELITY-2 W2 — rendered-material editor chrome + typography overhaul (re-grade r2)

q1_defects.answer: No broken, misaligned, or cut-off chrome in the new frames. All three r1 mustFix defects are visibly resolved: detail-card body copy is crisp white-on-dark glass instead of melted into the specular bloom; the Add Node dialog now has a labeled brass confirm key; no scene label pierces the inspector panel — the ringed sphere slides cleanly under the panel edge.
evidence: metrics: native crop of fix3 panel-left-edge (x2250-2850) shows scene sphere occluded by panel, zero label bleed-through vs 3 full-contrast pierces in before-inspector.png

q2_reads_as.answer: Reads as a lit, physical brass-and-glass instrument, not flat CSS. Dock tiles are dark plates with brass keylines and fully legible labels (Transform/Selection/Add/Image/3D Object/Text/Animation/Lighting/Build) vs the washed metal glint in w1-dock-hover-zoom.png. The canvas-to-galaxy sweep shows a real refractive pane with a brass keyline edge at mid-screen covering half the viewport. The keyframe shell is materialized in the same language: brass diamond keys, rate pills (1/60 active), mono captions.

q3_discoverable.answer: Primary actions are findable: the Add Node dialog's confirm key is now the brightest element in the dialog and labeled 'Add Node' (it was a blank dark area in before-add-node.png); Inspect/Edit on the detail card, Save & Verify in the inspector, and the keyframe transport (play/loop/rate) all read at a glance in the new frames.

q4_responsive.answer: Hover/pointer-reactive lighting is still alive but no longer destroys legibility: fix1 frames were captured with the pointer hovering near the surfaces and every text run survives (filter hint text fully readable end-to-end vs the blown-out hot spot in before-galaxy-filter.png). Mode transition is evidenced mid-flight in two frames plus a settled frame, so the sweep is a real animated state, not a claim.

q5_net.answer: PLEASED. Every r1 mustFix has frame-cited resolution, both previously unevidenced claims now have frames, and the chrome under deliberate worst-case capture (pointer hovering, panels overlapping) stays legible while keeping the lit-material look. Remaining items are taste/polish, recorded as flags.

flags.item: Add Node confirm key text contrast measures ~2.7:1 (glyph-core lum 0.024 vs same-row plate p90 lum 0.149) — below the 3:1 large-text line. Legible at a glance because it is the only bright plate in the dialog, but darkening the label one step would close it.
flags.evidence: metrics: fix2-add-node-zoom.png glyph-rows y50-90 x80-200, p05 lum 0.0244 vs p90 lum 0.1488 -> 2.67:1

flags.item: Inspector header bloom is still strong — the cream hot-spot behind 'Preview in App UI' and the tab row is near the legibility limit; LIVE PREVIEW caption is the lowest-contrast text in that region. Survives now, but no headroom if the pointer light is ever raised.
Filter palette glass over the open detail card lets the card body copy bleed through and interleave with the hint text — both legible, but visually busy when both surfaces are open.

Keyframe shell lanes and diamond keys render across the inspector's element-image preview (panel-over-panel z-order is deliberate, but the rightmost diamonds are harder to parse against the purple sphere).

No new dedicated dock-hover-with-pointer zoom was recaptured for the w1-dock-hover-zoom.png citation; resolution is inferred from the dock strip in fix1-detail-card-hover.png (all 9 labels legible, active Transform tile included) plus the global light reduction corroborated on three other surfaces.
